news.title: The reverse bridge: Crypto meets Wall Street using perps
news.summary: Crypto exchanges built perpetual futures for digital assets. Now they are using them to offer 24/7 exposure to stocks, commodities and indexes.

news.title: Unlike the FTX collapse, the $89 million Coldcard exploit has investors sending bitcoin back to exchanges
news.summary: The Coldcard vulnerability has smaller bitcoin holders moving funds onto exchanges for safety, according to blockchain analytics firms. This is opposite of the trend seen following the FTX collapse in late 2022.

news.title: Strategy holds STRC dividend at 12%
news.summary: Customarily, Michael Saylor and team have lifted the STRC dividend when it trades sizably below par, but not this month.

news.title: Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spreads to 4,500 addresses as losses near $89 million
news.summary: Galaxy Research flagged a third wave of sweeps tied to weak Coldcard-generated keys, with the attacker now targeting smaller balances and changing how funds are collected onchain.

news.title: Tokenized stock trading surged 288% in July, but one QQQ token drove most of it
news.summary: Without that QQQ token, QQQB, July volume for tokenized equities would be roughly $2.03 billion, about 30% below June’s total.

news.title: Bank of Italy research suggests stablecoins aren't necessarily cheaper for remittances
news.summary: A mystery-shopping experiment found that exchange fees, foreign exchange spreads and banking rails mean stablecoin remittances are often no cheaper than traditional transfer means.

news.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty shrinks 14% from this year's high as plunging revenues force operators to pivot
news.summary: Difficulty falls as weak mining economics reduce capacity, while forward markets signal little relief through year-end.

news.title: SEC to review Nasdaq bitcoin options approval after CME challenge
news.summary: CME argues that because bitcoin is a commodity, options tied to its value fall under CFTC jurisdiction, not the SEC's authority.

news.title: My ex-husband’s sister died — so why is Fidelity asking me for her death certificate?
news.summary: “Part of me jokes that paying for a death certificate would be like buying a lottery ticket.”

news.title: S&P 500 profit growth is getting even wilder as Amazon makes its mark
news.summary: Amazon is the latest Big Tech company to report abnormally large earnings growth, thanks to paper gains on Anthropic investments.

news.title: If Social Security’s funding crisis is the elephant in the room, this is the mouse everyone has overlooked. You have been warned.
news.summary: “Delaying Social Security until 70 results in an increased monthly payment — and that comes with proportionally higher cost-of-living adjustments.”

news.title: ‘We have always been civil’: My sister refuses to replace me as executor. Can I step down before she dies?
news.summary: “I haven’t seen my sister since our mother’s funeral more than 20 years ago.”

news.title: How Apple’s cheap MacBook Neo sparked a war in budget laptops
news.summary: Apple’s gamble on the budget MacBook Neo is paying off and forcing rivals to rethink their offerings.

news.title: Investors are rotating into financial stocks. The Fed’s next move could determine how far the rally runs.
news.summary: Financial stocks have been among the market’s best performers this month. The Fed’s next move, however, may determine how much further the rotation can run.

news.title: Financial stocks are crushing it. These charts show why the ‘breakout’ rally may have just begun.
news.summary: The breakout to record highs by bank stocks, plus their strong earnings and favorable valuations, suggest more good times ahead for the financial sector.
